prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The insurance policy does not _____ damage caused by floods, so the owner bought a separate plan.
options: cover
carry
cancel
contact

wrong.carry: carry 是「攜帶」，保險說明不會用它表示承保範圍。
wrong.cancel: cancel 是「取消」，句意是不涵蓋水災，而非取消損害。
wrong.contact: contact 是「聯絡」，不能接 damage 表示保險範圍。

why: 保險「承保」某種損失用 cover；因為不承保水災，所以另購保單。
tip: 保險 cover = 承保、涵蓋。
say: The insurance policy does not cover damage caused by floods, so the owner bought a separate plan.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Before approving the loan, the bank will carefully _____ the risk of the investment.
options: assess
assist
assume
assign

wrong.assist: assist 是「協助」，不能直接接 risk 表示評估風險。
wrong.assume: assume 是「假設、承擔」，銀行批准前要的是先評估，不是假設。
wrong.assign: assign 是「指派」，風險不是被指派的對象。

why: 批准貸款前需要評估風險，assess 是「評估」。
tip: assess the risk = 評估風險。
say: Before approving the loan, the bank will carefully assess the risk of the investment.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The company is insured against fire and theft.
The company is insured with fire and theft.
The company insured against fire and theft by itself is.
The company has insure against fire and theft.
answer: The company is insured against fire and theft.

wrong.The company is insured with fire and the: 投保某種風險要用 against，不是 with。
wrong.The company insured against fire and the: 語序混亂，is 不能放在句尾。
wrong.The company has insure against fire and: has 後面要接過去分詞 insured，不是原形。

why: be insured against + 風險，表示投保某種風險的保險。
say: The company is insured against fire and theft.

prompt: 客戶問你：「如果貨物在運送中損壞怎麼辦？」你要回答：「我們的保險會賠償。」哪一句最自然？
options: Our insurance will cover the loss.
Our insurance will be cover the loss.
Our insurance covering will the loss.
Our insurance is going to covers the loss.
answer: Our insurance will cover the loss.

will be 後面不能直接接原形 cover。
covering 不能放在 will 前面，語序混亂。
wrong.Our insurance is going to covers the los: going to 後面要接原形 cover，不能加 s。

why: will + 原形動詞表示未來承諾。
tip: will 或 going to 後面接原形。
say: Our insurance will cover the loss.

text: Customers who file a claim must attach photos of the damaged item.
options: 提出理賠申請的客戶必須附上受損物品的照片。
客戶必須把受損物品寄還給公司。
客戶不需要提供任何證明就可以理賠。
公司會為客戶拍攝受損物品的照片。
answer: 提出理賠申請的客戶必須附上受損物品的照片。

wrong.客戶必須把受損物品寄還給公司。: 原句要求的是照片，沒有說要寄回物品。
wrong.客戶不需要提供任何證明就可以理賠。: must attach photos 表示必須提供證明。
wrong.公司會為客戶拍攝受損物品的照片。: 拍照的人是客戶，主詞是 customers，不是公司。

why: file a claim 是提出理賠申請，must attach 說明必須附上。
tip: file a claim = 提出理賠申請。
say: Customers who file a claim must attach photos of the damaged item.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The two firms reached an _____ after three days of talks and signed the contract on Friday.
options: agreement
argument
advantage
announcement

wrong.argument: argument 是「爭論」，談判後簽約代表達成共識，不是爭論。
wrong.advantage: advantage 是「優勢」，reach an advantage 不是正確搭配。
wrong.announcement: announcement 是「宣布」，reach 通常不與它搭配。

why: reach an agreement 是固定搭配，談判之後才能簽約。
tip: reach an agreement = 達成協議。
say: The two firms reached an agreement after three days of talks and signed the contract on Friday.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: If the supplier lowers the price, we will sign the deal.
If the supplier will lower the price, we will sign the deal.
If the supplier lowered the price, we will sign the deal.
If the supplier lowers the price, we signed the deal.
answer: If the supplier lowers the price, we will sign the deal.

wrong.If the supplier will lower the price, we: if 子句不用 will，要用現在式 lowers。
wrong.If the supplier lowered the price, we wi: 時態不一致；真實條件句要用現在式加 will。
wrong.If the supplier lowers the price, we sig: 主句應該用 will sign 表示未來，而不是過去式。

why: 真實條件句：If + 現在式, will + 原形。
say: If the supplier lowers the price, we will sign the deal.
